tieu_de: Hardware Engineer RF Design/Test  Field Application
mo_ta_cong_viec:
1. RF Hardware Design & Development
• Design and develop RF-based automotive electronics including:
 Key fobs
 NFC modules
 Smart access control units
 Multi-functional body control units
• Support system architecture definition and translate system requirements into HW design.
• Work with technologies such as CAN, BLE, UWB, LF/RF communication in car access systems.
• Perform circuit design, simulation, and schematic/layout reviews using tools (e.g. PSpice, CST, Empire).
 
2. HW Validation & Testing (Focus for Vietnam Team)
• Build up prototypes and samples; perform hardware bring-up.
• Conduct:
o RF validation & debugging
o Embedded SW validation (interface with HW)
o Electrical and functional testing
• Develop and operate test setups, including:
o RF measurement equipment
o Automated/robotic test systems
o CAN-based interconnected control units
• Perform measurement, debugging, and root cause analysis on failures.
 
3. Field Application & Customer Support
• Execute vehicle-level testing and validation at customer sites.
• Analyse field data and provide technical feedback to development teams.
• Support front-end customer activities, including:
o Demo setups
o Application validation
o Technical presentations
• Act as HW interface to customers for issue resolution and technical clarification.
 
4. Industrialization & Project Contribution
• Support the full product lifecycle:
o Concept & architecture
o Development & validation
o Industrialization & SOP
• Collaborate with global teams (Germany, other regions) to ensure product readiness for mass production.
• Contribute to acquisition activities as RF/HW specialist.
 
5. Cross-functional Collaboration
• Work closely with:
o Hardware (HW) teams
o System engineering (SYS)
o Software development (SW / Embedded)
• Operate in an international, intercultural environment with strong teamwork culture.
yeu_cau:
Education & Experience
• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in:
o Electrical Engineering
o Electronics / Telecommunications
o Information Technology
• Experience in automotive hardware development or RF systems is highly preferred.
 
Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of:
RF design and measurement techniques
Automotive communication technologies (CAN, BLE, UWB, LF)
Radar / RF systems (advantage)
• Hands-on experience with:
RF lab equipment (spectrum analyzer, network analyzer, etc.)
Test system development and automation
• Familiarity with:
Simulation tools (PSpice, CST, Empire, etc.)
Embedded systems and HW-SW interaction
• Proficient in MS Office tools
Soft Skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Ability to work independently and within global teams
• Good communication and presentation skills
• Customer-oriented thinking
 
Language & Mobility
• Fluent in English (mandatory)
• Japanese is a plus
• Willingness to travel:
o Customer sites
o Global HELLA locations
o Supplier visits
quyen_loi:
Friendly working environment,
Competitive Salary
Training abroad opportunities

Besides competitive salary, we also offer other compelling benefits to our employees.
 
Our building is located in the center of Ho Chi Minh city, close to the airport and within walking distance to the central downtown.
The office is modern and bright, where our employees are working in an open office environment, with spacious and comfortable working stations. They are provided with novel appliances to fulfill their tasks at their best convenience. We have meeting rooms with modern conference call system which can be used to communicate with other HELLA locations. Working here, you also have a chance to learn from our specialists from all over the world, to work with international teams and to travel to Asia and Europe.
Our company has two fully equipped pantries for our employees with modern facilities and are well taken care of. To protect our employees, in addition to public health, our employees are granted private health care with favourable conditions for them and two other dependants.
Furthermore, we take our employee's happiness as one of our most important concerns. We hold an annual outing trip to help create a friendly and cooperative relationship in the company. We also offer other outdoor activities such as providing tickets to participate in public events (Color me run, Oktoberfest, etc.), and providing a staff recreation allowance for department team building activities, etc.
